correction: In Example, replaced π_i(S⁴)⊗Q and H_i(S⁴;Q) with $\pi_i(S^4)\otimes\mathbb Q$ and $H_i(S^4;\mathbb Q)$.

source_lines_after.33: Assume AC. For S⁴, the rational Hurewicz map is an isomorphism in degrees 4, 5, and 6: π₄(S⁴)⊗Q≅H₄(S⁴;Q)≅Q, and both $\pi_i(S^4)\otimes\mathbb Q$ and $H_i(S^4;\mathbb Q)$ vanish for i=5,6.
